CHOOSETHEANCIENT.settings.description.an: How many ancients appear in the initial vote.
CHOOSETHEANCIENT.settings.description.ga: Choose how the ancient selection flow is played.

Monty Hall: Two rounds; only the challenger previews an offering in round two.
Fair Fight: Two rounds; both finalists preview their offerings in round two.
I Want To Know Everything: One round; every ancient previews an offering, with no dialogue.
Simple Picker: One round, with no offering previews.
